scenario_requirements: Later certification must exercise Production evidence execution status through an authorized success and at least one stale, concurrent, denied, interrupted, or partial-failure path, and must assert the durable state, correlated receipt or event, consumer projection, visible recovery, and absence of unintended side effects.
